description: This file defines the WorkEffortSearch utility class for querying and filtering WorkEffort entities, including various search constraints (like assoc, keywords, last updated range) and sorting options, used within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch
classes.description: Main utility class providing methods to search for WorkEffort entities based on constraints and sorting, including sub-work effort retrieval and search context management.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchContext
classes.description: Encapsulates the state and parameters for performing a work effort search, including conditions, sorting, and result processing.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchConstraint
classes.description: Abstract base class for defining various search constraints used in WorkEffort searches.

classes.name: WorkEffortAssocConstraint
classes.description: Constraint to filter work efforts based on associations, including sub-efforts if specified.

classes.name: WorkEffortReviewConstraint
classes.description: Constraint for filtering based on review text content.

classes.name: PartyAssignmentConstraint
classes.description: Constraint for filtering work efforts based on party assignments.

classes.name: ProductSetConstraint
classes.description: Constraint for filtering work efforts by a set of product IDs.

classes.name: KeywordConstraint
classes.description: Constraint for filtering based on keyword search terms, with options for prefix/suffix matching and logical AND/OR combinations.

classes.name: LastUpdatedRangeConstraint
classes.description: Constraint to filter work efforts based on last modification date within a specified range.

classes.name: ResultSortOrder
classes.description: Abstract class for defining different sorting orders for search results.

classes.name: SortKeywordRelevancy
classes.description: Sort results based on keyword relevancy scoring.

classes.name: SortWorkEffortField
classes.description: Sort based on specific WorkEffort entity fields, such as name or last modified date.

methods.name: searchWorkEfforts
methods.description: Public static method to execute a search with a list of constraints and optional sort order, returning list of matching work effort IDs.

methods.name: getAllSubWorkEffortIds
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all sub-work effort IDs rooted at a given work effort ID, considering active date ranges.
